reuse.why: Expresses the rule through the existing recurConfigToRSchedule and rschedule's byDayOfWeek, so the existing post-processing (getDateWithSkippedWeekend) simply finds nothing to move.

duplication.why: A three-line change in one function; no logic is repeated.

placement.why: The recurrence definition in shared/schedules.ts is where frequency-specific rules (e.g. monthly patterns) already live.

scope.why: Only the daily branch of recurConfigToRSchedule and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Very small and clear, though the interplay with the later weekend-moving step is implicit and could merit a comment.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All occurrence generators (getNextDate, schedules app, rule-utils, find-schedules) go through recurConfigToRSchedule.

one_place.where: recurConfigToRSchedule in shared/schedules.ts, which every path that expands a schedule's recurrence uses.
